description:
29th October – Hosted Blood Donation Drive
On 29th October, our Club hosted the Blood Donation Camp from 10 am to 5 pm at CSMT Railway Station
The Camp was organised by Jagjivan Ram Hospital (Western Railway) Blood Centre, Mumbai Central. Volunteers of Lilavati College participated.
55 Units of Blood was collected supporting patients in need.
Attended by President Rtn Naresh Gupta.
Project cost Rs 25,000/-
